popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Father of Rhesus: when Dolon spies for Hector he names the Thracian king's lineage from Eioneus — pedigree of the snow-white horses Odysseus and Diomedes will steal.

popCulture.title: Rhesus of Thrace
popCulture.description: Eioneus is remembered almost wholly as father of Rhesus — the Thracian ally whose night raid ends in Iliad 10.

popCulture.title: Eioneus
popCulture.description: Thracian father of Rhesus in Homer — distinct from other mythic Eioneuses.
